info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Weather Alerts Subscribes-v5-spec
info.description: The Subscribe to Weather Alerts API allows users to access and list the current subscriptions for weather alerts. This resource is designed for developers looking to integrate real-time weather notifications into their applications, enhancing user awareness of weather conditions. Typical consumers include app developers in environmental services and emergency management sectors who require timely updates on severe weather alerts. By utilizing this API, businesses can keep their users informed, fostering proactive measures during adverse weather events.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to subscribe to real-time alerts for various events. By using this endpoint, users can configure their preferences and ensure they receive timely notifications regarding important updates.

requestBody.description: Request body for subscribing to alerts, which allows the client to specify the criteria or parameters for alerts they wish to receive.

200.description: The subscription request was successful and alerts are now being received.

ListWeatherAlertsSubscribesRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for subscribing to alerts.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the request.

resultId.description: The ID of the result related to the operation.

state.description: The current state of the operation.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the operation.

ListWeatherAlertsSubscribesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation on alerts subscription.
